PolicyAutonomyBudgetOutput.description: A rule's autonomy budget: `failures` within `window` degrade its effect.

PolicyCapability.description:
The class of action a policy rule governs.

`read` is always allowed (short-circuit). The mutating verbs (`propose` … `quarantine`) name coarse operations; `schema_change.additive`, `schema_change.breaking`, and `value_change` are *refinements* of the apply/promote verbs — a rule naming a bare verb (`apply`/`promote`) matches those refinements too, but a rule naming a refinement matches only that exact refinement.

oneOf.description: Read model output / metadata. Always allowed.
Draft a plan for later review.
Apply a plan against the warehouse.
Restore a gc-evicted artifact from its tombstone (*attempts* a rebuild, then verifies hash-exact — supported only for a recipe that reads no recorded upstreams; a multi-input recipe is refused).
An additive schema change (refinement of apply/promote).
A breaking schema change (refinement of apply/promote).
A value-only data change (refinement of apply/promote).

PolicyEffect.description:
The verdict a policy rule (or the default posture) yields.

Ordered by restrictiveness for incomparable-rule tie-breaking: `Deny` is a hard override (handled separately), and among non-deny verdicts `RequireReview` is more restrictive than `Allow`.

oneOf.description: Permit only after human review. The safe default posture.
Refuse the action. A hard override — no `allow` overturns it.

principal.description: The frozen principal. Absent on a marker that froze both.

scope.description: The scope selector as given to `rocky policy freeze`; `any` is every model.

since.description: When the freeze was recorded, when the source recorded it.

source.description: `"ledger"` (a `rocky policy freeze` decision) or `"marker"` (a durable freeze marker in the remote object tier).

PolicyFreezeSources.description: Which freeze sources the report read.

ledger.description: `"read"`, or `"absent"` when the project has no state store yet.

markers.description: `"read"`, or `"not_configured"` when `[state]` keeps no durable markers (a local backend, or `freeze_marker_writes = false`).

PolicyPrincipal.description:
Who is attempting an action.

`agent` is a non-human caller (an AI harness authoring, applying, or remediating). `human` is a person. In v0 the principal is supplied explicitly (`rocky policy check --principal …`); auto-detection is a later phase.

autonomy_budget.description: The rolling failure ceiling that degrades this rule's effect.

conditions.description: Free-form conditions the rule was written with, as authored. The engine parses them and never evaluates them: no `conditions` predicate narrows a rule's effect today, so a reader must not show them as part of what decided an outcome. They are here because a policy screen should be able to show what a rule's author wrote, including the part not yet in force.

id.description: Zero-based position in `[[policy.rules]]`; the `matched_rule` that `rocky policy check` reports.

PolicyRuleScopeOutput.description: What a rule matches. Every field is as authored; an empty list or `None` means the field does not narrow the rule.

max_downstreams.description: The blast-radius ceiling: the rule matches only a model with at most this many downstreams.

description:
JSON output for `rocky policy show`, and the body of `GET /api/v1/policy`: the policy plane as configured and as it stands.

The rules carry their position in `[[policy.rules]]` as `id`, the only identity a rule has today and the number `rocky policy check` reports as `matched_rule`. `freezes` is every freeze in force, from the decision ledger and, when the project keeps them, the durable freeze markers; `freeze_sources` says which of the two was read. A source that exists but cannot be read is an error, never an empty list: an empty list would say "nothing is frozen" for a plane whose freezes could not be read at all.

configured.description: Whether `rocky.toml` carries a `[policy]` block. `false` is the default posture: no rules, `default_agent_effect` as the engine defaults it.

default_agent_effect.description: The effect an agent gets when no rule matches.

freezes.description: Every freeze in force, ledger entries first, then markers.
